story: Ranchi student protest over alleged JPSC and JSSC exam irregularities
sourceText: For over a week now, tens of thousands of students have been protesting in Ranchi, Jharkhand over paper leak in JPSC & JSSC entrance exams. Images from tonight. Full ground reports by Harivansh Sharma on @NDTV.
titleInspiration: JHARKHAND WANTS SUPPORT! Thousands of students are protesting in Ranchi but no one cares anymore?

headline:
JHARKHAND NEEDS YOUR SUPPORT
THOUSANDS OF STUDENTS PROTEST
IN RANCHI, NO ONE CARES?
caption:
Tens of thousands of students have been protesting in Ranchi, Jharkhand, over alleged paper leaks and irregularities in JPSC and JSSC recruitment examinations. The supplied footage shows a large night march as aspirants demand accountability and a fair recruitment process.

The protest has continued for more than a week, according to the supplied report. Students say repeated examination problems have put years of preparation and their families’ savings at risk. Claims regarding individual responsibility and the full scope of the alleged irregularities should remain attributed until officially established.
